summary:
Leftover hwaccel_picture_private after a failed Vulkan hwaccel callback
in libavcodec/dpx.c. DPX hwaccel support was added in 8.1 (the CVE range
is "8.1 through 9.0.2"); dpx.c in 7.1.5 has no hwaccel code at all, so
upstream fix 170bbd41 has nothing to patch.
Refs:
  - https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/CVE-2026-125237
  - https://code.ffmpeg.org/FFmpeg/FFmpeg/commit/170bbd41d36d595b7ba4e97abea6d064fa695692
